name: The Red Moon
overview: Scripture reveals the phenomenon of the red moon as a significant prophetic sign preceding the great and terrible day of the Lord. Passages in Isaiah, Joel, Matthew, and Acts describe cosmic disturbances where the sun is darkened and the moon turns to blood, signaling divine judgment and the shaking of heavenly powers. These signs serve as warnings of imminent tribulation and the fulfillment of God's redemptive plan in Christ.
